Subject: 30-minute preview sync — pick two adjacent windows & exec backup

Hi Samira and Jeff — thanks again for a productive discovery today. Quick recap and next steps below, plus a couple of scheduling asks to lock the 30-minute product preview.

Recap (takeaways)
- Primary use case: near-real-time inference for multi-tenant ingestion pipelines (throughput focus at 5–10k reqs/min).
- Key constraints: HIPAA-adjacent PHI handling (so Private deployment likely), SLA requirement for 99.9% availability, and cost target below $0.08/token effective.
- Stakeholders to involve for the preview: your infra lead (Jeff), security/compliance (Samira), and ideally one exec sponsor (VP Product) for alignment on rollout timeline.

Proposed next step
- 30-minute product preview (concise demo + Q&A, recommended attendees: product + infra + compliance).

Could you pick two adjacent 30-minute windows from the options below in your timezone (PT)? Adjacent windows help us have a follow-up fallback window if the preferred time gets busy. I’ll lock one once you confirm and include our SME.
Option A: Tue 23 Sep — 09:00–09:30 PT or 09:30–10:00 PT
Option B: Wed 24 Sep — 11:00–11:30 PT or 11:30–12:00 PT

If you can also confirm an executive backup (VP Product or Head of AI) who could join the latter half if scheduling permits, that would help us ensure budget/timeline alignment.

I attached a short post-call notes PDF and a one-pager on the preview scope. If either of the adjacent pairs looks tight on your side, suggest two single 30-minute slots and we’ll adapt.

Thanks — I’ll hold the slots tentatively until EOD PT tomorrow.

Best,
Olga Petrov
